name: Sales Overview
query: SELECT category, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM sales_data GROUP BY category

name: Top Customers
query: SELECT customer_name, SUM(purchase_amount) AS total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10

name: Monthly Revenue
query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

name: Product Performance
query: SELECT product_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM order_items GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC

name: Website Traffic
query: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS visitors FROM website_traffic GROUP BY country ORDER BY visitors DESC

name: Conversion Funnel
query: SELECT stage, COUNT(user_id) AS users FROM conversion_funnel GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage

name: Customer Retention
query: SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS retained_users FROM user_activity GROUP BY cohort_month ORDER BY cohort_month

name: Sales by Region
query: SELECT region, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_sales DESC

name: Average Order Value
query: SELECT AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM orders

name: Inventory Stock Levels
query: SELECT product_name, stock_quantity FROM inventory WHERE stock_quantity < 50 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC
